dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do any of your "friends" have it out for you, by any chance...?

dialogues.speaker: Czcibor
dialogues.text: You're saying someone planned it? I don't think so. I'm not someone worth robbing.

dialogues.speaker: Czcibor
dialogues.text: And I don't know why, but I feel like my kuuvahki adaptability has improved by leaps and bounds. If things continue to go on the upswing, I might even be able to find more work. That's the best kind of ending I can hope for.
